$comment: Acceptance criteria for issue 126, declared before the work. THE ISSUE'S OWN DIAGNOSIS WAS WRONG and was corrected on the issue first: the pattern does not require the word 'suites' -- it has four alternatives and 16/16 is matched by one of them. The real defect is that the pattern enumerates PHRASINGS, so a bare N/N that is neither preceded by 'Expect' nor followed by 'pass' matches nothing, and a count claim no alternative matches is indistinguishable from no claim at all. Criterion 1 is therefore not 'add N/N to the list' -- that is one more phrasing and leaves the shape intact -- but that a document contradicting itself is caught. Criterion 2 is the mutation-shaped one: reverting CONTRIBUTING.md line 50 to a wrong count must redden the suite, which is the only thing that proves the check can see it at all.
